name: Hall of Champions
summary: Within the Scarlet Monastery's armory wing, the Hall of Champions tests the Crusade's elite. Herod, the Scarlet Champion, leads its fiercest fighters from this inner sanctum.

sections.title: Seat of the Scarlet Champion
sections.body:
Beyond the Footman's Armory, you come to the Hall of Champions at the heart of the monastery's armory wing. Herod, the Scarlet Champion, commands the Crusade's fiercest fighters here.

Scarlet trainees sharpen their resolve and skill for the Crusade's aim: to purge Lordaeron of all undead and outsiders.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of Champions?
faq.answer: The Hall of Champions is the inner sanctum of the monastery's armory and a proving ground for the Scarlet Crusade's elite. Herod, the Scarlet Champion, leads its fighters while trainees hone their skills for the war against the undead.

faq.q: Who are the people immortalized in the statues?
faq.answer: No champions memorialized here are named in the records of this era. Herod, the Scarlet Champion, is the hall's best-known figure and guards the chamber.

faq.q: How does this hall differ from Stormwind's Champions' Hall?
aliases: hall of champions vs champions hall
faq.answer: Though their names are similar, the Hall of Champions lies deep inside the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and honors Scarlet figures. Stormwind City's Champions' Hall is a military garrison reserved for Alliance officers and PvP quartermasters.

angles.text: As a knight of the Holy Light, facing Herod, the Scarlet Champion, in his own hall reminds you that genuine virtue and faith can twist into zealotry.
As a human traveler from Lordaeron, you may recognize former defenders of the northern kingdoms among the Crusade's champions. They have thrown their lot in with the fanatical Crusade.
